newsitem.title: USA: Marathon, Texaco have Ewing Bank find.
newsitem.headline: Marathon, Texaco have Ewing Bank find.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co said Monday a new oil discovery was made with Texaco Exploration and Production Inc on Ewing Bank Block 917 in the Gulf of Mexico, 130 miles south of New Orleans.
Ewing Bank 917 No. 1 was drilled in 1,185 feet of water and has been temporarily suspended, pending design and installation of subsea facilities, Marathon said.

The well will be tied back to Marathon's and Texaco's jointly owned Ewing Bank Block 873 platform three miles to the north, which will also serve as a hub for other satellite developments in the area.

The Ewing Bank 917 No. 1 was drilled to 12,300 feet, encountering oil pay below 11,500 feet. Based on 3-D seismic interpretations, this single-well development is expected to recover about 10 million barrels of oil equivalent, with first production in early 1998, Marathon said.

The Diamond Offshore "Lexington," under extended contract to Marathon for deepwater exploration and development, has been moved about three miles south to delineate and develop Marathon's and Texaco's discovery on Ewing Bank Block 963.
Marathon owns a 66.67 percent working interest in Ewing Bank Block 917. Texaco holds the remaining 33.33 percent.
Marathon Oil is a unit of the USX-Marathon Group of USX Corp. Texaco Exploration is a Texaco Inc subsidiary.
